labels.delegated: (The user chose "leave it all to you": go with your recommendations)
labels.plan_approved: The user approved the plan and picked the name "{name}". Start writing.
labels.plan_rejected: The user sent the plan back. What they want changed:
labels.changes: (Your proposed changes and the user's decisions: accepted, rejected, stale = the user already edited it by hand, pending = not decided yet)
labels.images: (You showed some images for the user to pick from: {ids})

errors.sent: Sent to the user. This round ends here.
errors.check_ok: The check passed with no problems.
errors.no_field: There's no field called {field}. You can write: name, display_name, tags, description, personality, scenario, first_mes, mes_example, system_prompt, creator_notes.
errors.no_entry: There's no lorebook entry {index}. Use read_draft to see the entries and their numbers.
errors.no_asset: There's no such image in the draft: {asset_id}.
errors.license: This image's license is {license}, so it can't be the cover directly: ask the user to confirm "personal use only" in the cover panel, or use a public domain, generated or uploaded image instead.
errors.user_edited: {where} was edited by the user; don't overwrite it. If it really needs changing, ask the user in the chat first and pass user_confirmed once they agree.
errors.draft_gone: The draft is gone, or the user has taken over this round. Stop and don't write anything else.
errors.busy: The user is editing the draft at the same time and writes keep conflicting. Stop for now and tell the user to ask you to continue later.
errors.bad_todos: items needs at least one item, each with text and state (todo, doing, done).
errors.limit_tools: This round has used more than {max} tool calls; no more are allowed. Tell the user in a sentence or two how far you got, and continue when they say so.
errors.limit_searches: This round has done more than {max} searches. Continue with what you have.
errors.limit_pages: This round has read more than {max} pages. Continue with what you have.
errors.limit_images: The approved plan only allows {max} generated images and they're used up. Ask the user before making more.
errors.no_page: There's no page with id {page_id}. Use the id web_fetch returned.
errors.page_more: lines {start} to {end} of {total} were left out; read them with read_page, page_id {page_id}
errors.images_generated: Generated and saved to the draft: {ids}. Show them to the user with show_images.
